items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: So Benny Goodman had the band at Seven Lively Arts, which the stars were Bea Lillie, Burt Lahr and Benny Goodman.

ctx.x: I know you did Seven Lively Arts with him.

No, I took the band in Seven Lively Arts. See, there's the thing. Billy Rose produced Carmen Jones and Seven Lively Arts. See Carmen Jones was at the Broadway Theatre right there at 53rd and Broadway, where Seven Lively Arts was at 52nd and Sixth Avenue, 51st and 6th Avenue. So Billy Rose produced both of them. So Benny Goodman had the band at Seven Lively Arts, which the stars were Bea Lillie, Burt Lahr and Benny Goodman. So Benny had the band, five pieces.
Oh that's all it was. I thought it was a big band.
